text:
faye: Tiny holiday idea: plant & postcard mini-swap! No pressure, swap a small plant clipping or seed packet + a short postcard note. Tag one person when you join. I'll start: im in, sending a cuttings packet. :seedling:

omar: love this. i'm down. can we do a contactless drop spot in the lobby? 

facilities-bot: FYI: Lobby dropbox available at reception 9am-6pm Mon-Fri through Dec 22. Please label items with recipient's name. :package:

ravi: labeling note: please avoid soil mess, small sealed bag works. my memory for the postcard note: that time we celebrated shipping the caching improvement. tiny winner energy. tagging @luna to keep it going.

luna: i'm in! posting a pic of my goofy holiday plant sweater. :evergreen_tree: will DM address or use the dropbox. tagging @faye back. Happy cozy low-key holidays everyone.
